statement: Nebius is raising on-demand GPU rental prices by roughly 17%-21% effective October 1, 2026, with B300 going from $7.85 to $9.50 per hour, a 21% increase and a cumulative rise of as much as 56% since May 2026.
why: A second rental price increase within months, on the newest Blackwell Ultra parts, is the clearest read that rentable accelerator capacity is scarce relative to demand.

impact.mechanism: Rising posted rental rates on scarce current-generation capacity indicate demand outrunning available fleets, which supports continued accelerator ordering by cloud operators.

evidence.source: KuCoin News (flash article), corroborated by Futu News

confidence.basis: Secondary flash article resting on Odaily's read of private customer notices; no Nebius blog or press release covering this increase was found at fetch time.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 4.5 -> 9.5 (tol 1%); sources: KuCoin News (flash article), corroborated by Futu News
